title: sar-decision-qa
description: Structured second-line QA record for a single SAR / no-SAR decision file. Captures alert summary, customer and account context, investigation steps, evidence considered, disposition (filed / not-filed-closed / closed-with-continuing-review / escalated-pending), decision rationale, confidentiality posture, continuing-activity posture, QA reviewer findings, material gaps, and the QA recommendation. The skill produces QA artifacts only; the BSA officer or designated decisionmaker files, amends, declines, or closes any SAR.

alert_id.description: Canonical alert identifier (placeholder for sample). Stable across QA cycles.

engagement_id.description: Optional pointer to the scope record under which this QA was produced.

as_of_date.description: Date the QA review was last revised.

review_type.description: Why this QA is being produced. Drives sample selection and depth.

alert_type.description: Origin of the alert. Drives the investigation-step expectation set.

scenario_name.description: Monitoring scenario or rule that generated the alert. Null when non-system.

monetary_footprint.description: Financial scale of the activity under review.

customer_segment.description: Segment per the firm's CDD risk model: e.g., consumer-low-risk, small-business-medium-risk, MSB, correspondent, private-banking, foreign-PEP-related.

prior_sar_history.description: Prior SAR filings at the customer or related-party level. Drives the continuing-activity read.

investigation_steps.description: Dated, attributed investigation steps with evidence pointers. A free-text paragraph is not enough to QA against the timeline.

evidence_pointer.description: System-of-record reference, document ID, or file path.

evidence_considered.description: Categories of evidence the investigator pulled or reviewed.

disposition.description: What the BSA program did with the alert. The QA reviews this disposition; it does not set, change, or recommend a change to it as a directive.

filing_window_status.description: Where disposition is filed: timing posture against the 30-day rule (60 days where no suspect identified). For other dispositions: not-applicable.

decision_rationale.description: What the rationale says and how it cites typology and advisory.

typology.description: Named typology cited (e.g., structuring, layering, trade-based money laundering, account takeover, ransomware, elder financial exploitation, sanctions evasion via virtual currency).

advisory_reference.description: FinCEN advisory or other public-source reference cited in the narrative, dated.

narrative_summary.description: One-paragraph plain-language summary of the rationale as written in the decision file.

narrative_coherence_label.description: QA judgment on whether the narrative ties evidence to typology to disposition.

confidentiality_posture.description: 31 USC 5318(g) confidentiality and tipping-off posture for this decision.

tipping_off_risk_assessed.description: True only when the file evidences a tipping-off assessment specific to this decision (especially in fraud-recovery, EDD-overlap, and law-enforcement-liaison cases).

internal_access_controls_documented.description: True when the file evidences need-to-know access controls on the SAR record.

notification_avoidance_controls.description: Free-text note on the controls in place: messaging-template restrictions, customer-call scripts, account-action language.

continuing_activity.description: Continuing-activity posture per the 90-day continuing-review expectation.

prior_sar_link.description: Reference to prior SAR(s) this alert relates to. Empty when none.

last_continuing_review_date.description: Date of the most recent continuing-review entry. Reviews concluding 'no continuing activity' are still papered.

next_review_due.description: Date the next continuing review falls due.

review_cadence_status.description: Whether the 90-day cadence is being met.

qa_findings.description: Criteria-aligned findings against the alert decision file. Each finding ties to a named criterion, not to a generic 'quality' bucket.

evidence_pointer.description: Where in the decision file the finding is evidenced.

material_gaps.description: Specific evidence or documentation the QA reviewer flagged as missing. Each item carries the criterion it bears on.

recommendation.description: QA recommendation. The recommendation is consultative input to the BSA officer or SAR review committee. The skill does not file, decline, amend, supplement, or close any SAR.

recommendation_notes.description: Detail behind the recommendation: what to escalate, what training feedback to give, what process change to consider.

review_gates.description: Named human-review gates this QA artifact must clear before the recommendation is acted on. Drawn from references/review-gates.md when present.

owner.description: Role of the QA reviewer. E.g., second-line BSA QA reviewer, internal audit secondee, advisory engagement manager.

approver.description: Role that signs off the QA artifact. Typically BSA officer, head of financial-crime QA, or SAR review committee chair, depending on the firm.

confidence_label.description: Confidence in the QA read, per references/review-gates.md when present.

source_trace.description: Citations supporting material claims in the QA. Every claim should be traceable.
